hyperedges.label: JWT Authentication Chain: Login→Store Token→Request Interceptor→Response Expiry Handler
Shared Detail+Remarks Pattern: Clue and Activity both use detail view with nested remark recording
Clue-to-Customer Conversion Pipeline: ClueView calls convertClueToCustomer API, which transforms t_clue records into t_customer records
System Monitoring Pipeline: SystemView polls system.js API endpoints, mapping SystemMonitorDTO fields (AllMonitorData, MemoryInfo, CpuInfo, JvmInfo) to ECharts visualizations on the dashboard

RBAC Permission System: t_permission defines hierarchical menu/button permissions, t_role grants permissions via t_role_permission join, DashboardView renders menu based on user's menuPermissionList from /api/login/info
Authentication Response Pipeline
hyperedges.description: All 4 auth handlers (Success, Failure, Logout, AccessDenied) follow the same pattern: construct R result → JSONUtils.toJSON → ResponseUtils.write

hyperedges.label: Excel Name-to-ID Converter Pattern
hyperedges.description: All 4 converters follow identical pattern: read cell string → lookup name in DlykServerApplication.cacheMap via DicEnum key → return matched ID or -1

hyperedges.label: Login/Logout JWT-Redis Flow
hyperedges.description: MyAuthenticationSuccessHandler creates JWT+stores in Redis; MyLogoutSuccessHandler removes JWT from Redis; both depend on Constants for key prefix and TUser for user identity

hyperedges.label: Dictionary Cache Used by Excel Converters
Remark Tracking Pattern
hyperedges.description: All three remark classes share an identical tracking-record structure with noteWay, noteContent, createTime, createBy, editTime, editBy, deleted fields — following the same remark/tracking pattern across clue, customer, and transaction domains.

hyperedges.label: Sales Conversion Pipeline
hyperedges.description: CustomerManager.convertCustomer implements the TClue→TCustomer→TTran conversion flow, while StatisticManager.loadSaleFunnelData reports on the same funnel stages (clue→customer→tran→deal). Both managers depend on TClueMapper and TCustomerMapper to operate on this pipeline.

hyperedges.label: System Info Duality
hyperedges.description: TSystemInfo and TSystem represent the same system configuration entity (systemCode, name, site, logo, title, etc.) but differ in types: TSystemInfo uses java.util.Date fields while TSystem uses java.time.LocalDateTime, suggesting a model evolution or parallel representation of the same database table.

hyperedges.label: Product Management Subsystem
hyperedges.rationale: These services collectively manage the product lifecycle: product CRUD, categories, promotions, and stock records.

hyperedges.label: Transaction Management Subsystem
hyperedges.rationale: TTran is the transaction entity; TTranProduct and TTranInvoice are sub-entities linked by tranId; TranService orchestrates all.

hyperedges.label: Remark CRUD Service Pattern
hyperedges.rationale: Both services follow identical CRUD patterns for remark entities tied to a parent domain object (activity/clue).
